name: Half a Wreath of Roses
source:
A  knight surprises a young man weaving a wreath of roses in his father's overgrown grove.

[from [url=https://glueblade.itch.io/half-a-wreath]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位骑士让一位年轻人在他父亲杂草丛生的小树林里编织玫瑰花环时感到惊讶。
